title: human-assisted-software-development
description: HASD and what uses it: the repositories that copy its skills and knowledge catalogue, and the explorer that shows the .dev folders written to them.

components.name: human-assisted-software-development
components.responsibility: Keeps the original of the methodology's skills and knowledge catalogue.

components.name: Agents
components.responsibility: The skills, view schemas, knowledge catalogue and the two validators an agent uses to document a repository in .dev folders.

components.name: Repository that adopts HASD
components.responsibility: Copies Agents/Skills and Agents/Knowledge to Meta/Agents/, documents its folders in .dev folders and Actors/, and runs the validators from there.

components.name: Cyberspace explorer
components.responsibility: Shows a repository's .dev folders; it lives in its own repository.

relationships.description: The repository's one maintained folder of content.
Copies Skills/ and Knowledge/ unchanged to Meta/Agents/ and follows them.
Reads .dev files written to the view schemas and knowledge catalogue.
